## Description

Buy puts to limit downside, optionally selling calls to finance some of the premium.

## Where it may fit

Portfolio drawdown control, concentrated holdings, event risk or a defined insurance horizon.

## Vehicles

Long-only equity funds, ETF portfolios, institutional hedging overlays.

## Required data

Portfolio/underlying values, put/call chains, expiries, strikes, implied vol, dividend/rates and hedge sizing.

## Caveats

Insurance costs can be substantial; collars cap upside and protection ends at expiry unless renewed.
